name: Παραλία Γλυφάδας Ακτή Γ
evidence: Glyfada's organized Asteras/Akti beaches are described as sandy ('unique sandy beach with turquoise waters'), though the far-north edge is slightly pebbly; disambiguated to the Glyfada Riviera coast (37.86N).

name: Νησίδα Φλέβες
evidence: 'Paralia Fleves is covered with sand and rocks' on this rocky uninhabited islet off Vouliagmeni; the ~40m beach pocket itself is sandy (rocks form the surrounding shore), so sand is the beach material.

name: Άλιμος Λουτρά
evidence: Alimos (Loutra) organized Athens-Riviera beach is 'covered with white sand and fine pebbles'; predominantly white sand; disambiguated to the Loutra tram-stop beach in Alimos.

name: Όρμος Ληδάκι
evidence: No beach-specific source found for 'Ληδάκι' cove on the Nea Makri/Rafina coast (38.03N); neighbouring coves (Ag. Andreas) are sand+fine-pebble, but the exact beach could not be pinned, so we keep our current label.

name: Πόρτο Ράφτη Αυλάκι
evidence: Avlaki (Markopoulo, blue-flag) is an organized beach 'with sand' but 'the shore is pebbly' turning sandy in the sea; sand-and-pebble mix, not pure pebbles; disambiguated to the Porto Rafti/Markopoulo Avlaki (37.87N).

name: Ωρωπός Σκάλα Ωρωπού
evidence: Skala Oropou beach is a 'soft sandy shore interspersed with pebbles... beach is pebbly, water shoes recommended, pebbles the main characteristic'; disambiguated to Skala Oropou on the North Euboean Gulf (38.32N).

name: Λουτρά
evidence: Loutra (Souvala, Aegina) is 'sandy and organized' though described as 'a small beach of coarse sand and shingle'; predominantly sand; disambiguated to Loutra Souvalas on Aegina's north coast (37.77N).

name: Αίγινα Μαραθώνας
evidence: Marathonas A/B on Aegina is a 'long sandy beach with crystal-clear shallow water', both sections sandy and family-friendly; disambiguated to Marathonas 4km from Aegina town (37.72N).

name: Παραλία Καλάμι
evidence: Kalami (Kythira) 'consists of pebbles and some sand... it has fine pebbles', a hard-to-reach cove reached from Mylopotamos; disambiguated to the center-west Kythira Kalami below Mylopotamos (36.25N).

name: Παραλία Λίμνη (Παλαιόπολη)
evidence: Limni/Paleopoli beach is 'a unique blend of crimson pebbles and pristine white sands... red and white fine pebbles'; genuine sand-and-pebble mix, not sand-only; disambiguated to the Paleopoli bay, Kythira (36.22N).

name: Φυρή Άμμος (Κάλαμος)
evidence: Fyri Ammos (Kalamos) is 'a long beach with red sand and pebbles' (blue-flag, name literally = red sand); definitely not rocks; disambiguated to the SE-Kythira Fyri Ammos near Kalamos (36.17N).

name: Παραλία Αγίου Νικολάου
evidence: North Agios Nikolaos beach on Salamina is classified 'pebble' ('a great beach with pebbles', blue-flag organized); disambiguated to the north Salamina Agios Nikolaos (37.88N).

name: Μικρή Ζωγεριά
evidence: The small/secluded Zogeria cove has 'a mixture of sand, dirt, and pebbles where the water breaks' (the large cove is coarse sand); disambiguated to Mikri Zogeria on Spetses' north side (37.28N).

name: Παραλία Πόρτο Γερμενό
evidence: Porto Germeno is 'a pebble beach... covered in small beige pebbles, the seabed very fine pebbles', split into three beaches of sand-and-small-pebble mix but pebble-dominant; disambiguated to Porto Germeno, Gulf of Corinth (38.15N).

name: Παραλία Πολιτικών
evidence: Politika beach is 'covered in fine pebbles mixed with dark sand... dark sand punctuated by white and gray pebbles'; genuine sand-and-pebble mix; disambiguated to Politika, central Evia N-Euboean Gulf (38.77N).

name: Σχοινοδαύλεια
evidence: Schinodavlia (aka Agios Dimitrios) is 'listed among the sandy beaches of Karystos' with shallow warm clean water; disambiguated to the south-Evia/Karystos gorge beach (38.14N).

name: Παραλία Χιλιαδού
evidence: Chiliadou (Fokida/Dorida, near Nafpaktos) is 'a very beautiful beach with pebble outside and sand in the sea' - the walking shore is pebble; disambiguated to the Fokida Chiliadou 7km from Nafpaktos (38.39N), not the Evia one.

name: Diaporti
evidence: Diaporti (Vourvourou, Sithonia) mostly described as 'gravel and pebbles with a pebbled sea bottom... a pebble/stone beach not really suitable for lying down' (one outlier says fine white sand); disambiguated to Diaporti by the Pounta islet, Sithonia (40.01N).

name: Παραλία Πύργου
evidence: Pirgos beach (Halkidiki) is 'a secluded, pebbly beach with a few farmhouses among plane trees and fishing boats' per Visit Halkidiki; disambiguated to Pyrgos near Metamorfosi/Nikiti on the Toroneos gulf neck (40.25N).

name: Αμμουλιανή
evidence: Ammouliani island beaches (Alykes, Megali Ammos, Karagatsia) are 'white/golden sand with crystal-clear shallow water'; disambiguated to Ammouliani island off the Athos gulf (40.33N).
